description: This file defines a set of classes and functions for interacting with the Gmail API, including operations for managing drafts, messages, labels, and threads. It includes schema definitions, request handling, and factory functions to create specific tools based on requested actions.

classes.name: BaseGmailTool
classes.description: A base class extending DynamicStructuredTool, providing common methods for making Gmail API requests and creating MIME messages.

methods.name: createGmailTools
methods.description: Factory function that creates and returns an array of Gmail tool instances based on specified actions.
